standard: ISO C11 threads through actual MSVC target headers and runtime
reference_note: Real threads.h and target runtime only. Concurrent data use mutexes or _Atomic. Retry stress is probabilistic and cannot replace a forced-failure gate.

cases.source:
#include <threads.h>
int worker(void *p){return *(int*)p+22;}int main(void){thrd_t t;int n=20,r=0;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,&n)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(thrd_join(t,&r)!=thrd_success)return 2;return r;}

#include <threads.h>
int main(void){thrd_t a=thrd_current(),b=thrd_current();return thrd_equal(a,b)?42:1;}

#include <threads.h>
thrd_t parent;int worker(void *p){(void)p;return thrd_equal(thrd_current(),parent)?1:42;}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;parent=thrd_current();if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 2;thrd_join(t,&r);return r;}

#include <threads.h>
int worker(void *p){(void)p;thrd_exit(42);}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 1;thrd_join(t,&r);return r;}

#include <threads.h>
_Thread_local int n=20;int worker(void *p){(void)p;n+=22;return n;}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;n=7;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 1;thrd_join(t,&r);return r==42&&n==7?42:2;}

#include <threads.h>
_Thread_local int n=20;int worker(void *p){return &n==(int*)p?1:42;}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,&n)!=thrd_success)return 2;thrd_join(t,&r);return r;}

#include <threads.h>
mtx_t m;int n;int worker(void *p){(void)p;for(int i=0;i<1000;++i){mtx_lock(&m);++n;mtx_unlock(&m);}return 0;}int main(void){thrd_t a,b;int r;if(mtx_init(&m,mtx_plain)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(thrd_create(&a,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 2;if(thrd_create(&b,worker,0)!=thrd_success){thrd_join(a,&r);return 3;}thrd_join(a,&r);thrd_join(b,&r);mtx_destroy(&m);return n==2000?42:4;}

#include <threads.h>
int main(void){mtx_t m;if(mtx_init(&m,mtx_recursive)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(mtx_lock(&m)!=thrd_success)return 2;if(mtx_trylock(&m)!=thrd_success)return 3;mtx_unlock(&m);mtx_unlock(&m);mtx_destroy(&m);return 42;}

#include <threads.h>
mtx_t m;int worker(void *p){(void)p;int r=mtx_trylock(&m);if(r==thrd_success)mtx_unlock(&m);return r==thrd_busy?42:1;}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;if(mtx_init(&m,mtx_plain)!=thrd_success)return 2;mtx_lock(&m);if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 3;thrd_join(t,&r);mtx_unlock(&m);mtx_destroy(&m);return r;}

#include <threads.h>
mtx_t m;cnd_t c;int ready,n;int worker(void *p){(void)p;mtx_lock(&m);while(!ready)cnd_wait(&c,&m);int r=n;mtx_unlock(&m);return r;}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;if(mtx_init(&m,mtx_plain)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(cnd_init(&c)!=thrd_success)return 2;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 3;mtx_lock(&m);n=42;ready=1;cnd_signal(&c);mtx_unlock(&m);thrd_join(t,&r);cnd_destroy(&c);mtx_destroy(&m);return r;}

#include <threads.h>
mtx_t m;cnd_t c;int ready;int worker(void *p){(void)p;mtx_lock(&m);while(!ready)cnd_wait(&c,&m);mtx_unlock(&m);return 21;}int main(void){thrd_t a,b;int x,y;if(mtx_init(&m,mtx_plain)!=thrd_success||cnd_init(&c)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(thrd_create(&a,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 2;if(thrd_create(&b,worker,0)!=thrd_success){mtx_lock(&m);ready=1;cnd_broadcast(&c);mtx_unlock(&m);thrd_join(a,&x);return 3;}mtx_lock(&m);ready=1;cnd_broadcast(&c);mtx_unlock(&m);thrd_join(a,&x);thrd_join(b,&y);cnd_destroy(&c);mtx_destroy(&m);return x+y;}

#include <threads.h>
once_flag flag=ONCE_FLAG_INIT;int n;void initialize(void){++n;}int worker(void *p){(void)p;call_once(&flag,initialize);return 0;}int main(void){thrd_t a,b;int r;if(thrd_create(&a,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(thrd_create(&b,worker,0)!=thrd_success){thrd_join(a,&r);return 2;}call_once(&flag,initialize);thrd_join(a,&r);thrd_join(b,&r);return n==1?42:3;}

#include <threads.h>
int main(void){tss_t key;int n=42;if(tss_create(&key,0)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(tss_set(key,&n)!=thrd_success)return 2;int r=*(int*)tss_get(key);tss_delete(key);return r;}

#include <threads.h>
tss_t key;_Atomic int n;void destroy(void *p){if(*(int*)p==42)++n;}int data=42;int worker(void *p){(void)p;return tss_set(key,&data);}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;if(tss_create(&key,destroy)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 2;thrd_join(t,&r);tss_delete(key);return r==thrd_success&&n==1?42:3;}

#include <threads.h>
tss_t key;int a=20,b=22;int worker(void *p){(void)p;if(tss_get(key)!=0)return 1;if(tss_set(key,&b)!=thrd_success)return 2;return *(int*)tss_get(key);}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;if(tss_create(&key,0)!=thrd_success)return 3;if(tss_set(key,&a)!=thrd_success)return 4;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 5;thrd_join(t,&r);int own=*(int*)tss_get(key);tss_delete(key);return own+r;}

#include <threads.h>
int main(void){struct timespec duration={0,0};thrd_yield();return thrd_sleep(&duration,0)==0?42:1;}

#include <threads.h>
int main(void){mtx_t m;cnd_t c;struct timespec ts;if(mtx_init(&m,mtx_plain)!=thrd_success||cnd_init(&c)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(timespec_get(&ts,TIME_UTC)!=TIME_UTC)return 2;--ts.tv_sec;mtx_lock(&m);int r=thrd_success;for(int i=0;i<100&&r==thrd_success;++i)r=cnd_timedwait(&c,&m,&ts);int unlocked=mtx_unlock(&m);cnd_destroy(&c);mtx_destroy(&m);return r==thrd_timedout&&unlocked==thrd_success?42:3;}

#include <threads.h>
mtx_t m;int worker(void *p){(void)p;struct timespec ts;if(timespec_get(&ts,TIME_UTC)!=TIME_UTC)return 1;--ts.tv_sec;int r=mtx_timedlock(&m,&ts);if(r==thrd_success)mtx_unlock(&m);return r==thrd_timedout?42:2;}int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;if(mtx_init(&m,mtx_timed)!=thrd_success)return 3;mtx_lock(&m);if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 4;thrd_join(t,&r);mtx_unlock(&m);mtx_destroy(&m);return r;}

#include <threads.h>
_Atomic int done;int worker(void *p){(void)p;done=1;return 0;}int main(void){thrd_t t;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(thrd_detach(t)!=thrd_success)return 2;while(!done)thrd_yield();return 42;}

#include <threads.h>
_Atomic int n;int worker(void *p){(void)p;for(int i=0;i<1000;++i)++n;return 0;}int main(void){thrd_t a,b;int r;if(thrd_create(&a,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 1;if(thrd_create(&b,worker,0)!=thrd_success){thrd_join(a,&r);return 2;}thrd_join(a,&r);thrd_join(b,&r);return n==2000?42:3;}

#include <threads.h>
extern _Thread_local int shared;int worker(void*);int main(void){thrd_t t;int r;shared=7;if(thrd_create(&t,worker,0)!=thrd_success)return 1;thrd_join(t,&r);return r==42&&shared==7?42:2;}
